svg.title: lect13d p1 numbered complement spindle
svg.desc: Source complement above source spindle pairing. Detached source identifiers are aligned to complement row ancestry: blue-centromere translocation4, red-centromere translocation1, normal blue2, normal red3. Source text order4,1,2,3 retained.

svg.title: translocation-heterozygote
svg.desc: Two translocated and two normal chromosomes; exact image003 complement. Original teaching schematic, not to scale.

svg.title: pairing-spindle
svg.desc: Alternate spindle attachments: one pole connects centromeres 1 and 4, the other connects 2 and 3. Four replicated chromosomes, eight chromatids. Schematic perspective. Original schematic based on LECT13D image_006 and image_008.
